title: Qui-Gon Jinn
description: Qui-Gon Jinn was a Jedi Master whose Padawan was Obi-Wan Kenobi. He discovered the Jedi potential in young Anakin Skywalker. During the Battle of Naboo, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan fought the Sith apprentice, Darth Maul. Maul killed Qui-Gon before falling to Obi-Wan. years later, Qui-Gon appeared to Obi-Wan on Tatooine as a Force ghost.
